summary: Phase 12 — Validated role-specific dashboards, /governance prompt-policy approval flow, sidebar role gating, editability gate, and cross-tenant super_admin notifications across 20 demo accounts. Backend 28/28 + Phase10 regression 31/31 = 59/59. Frontend: 13/13 dashboards dispatched, 8/8 governance rows + approve/pause/HITL toggle + audit feed working, sidebar gating correct for 6 roles, compliance officer is Read-only with all 8 hitl switches disabled, /compliance and /workflows still load.
critical_code_review_comments: Governance: gov-row/gov-risk/gov-hitl/gov-cites/gov-status/gov-approve/gov-pause testids use the use-case `key` field (e.g. ai_instructor, psychometrics) — NOT the dotted module codes 4.1..4.8 mentioned as examples in the review request. Tests should target the actual key strings. This is intentional and consistent.

routes_messaging.py: super_admin GET inbox uses $or filter [user_id, role==super_admin, role=='*']. This means super_admin cannot see role-broadcast notifications targeted to other roles (e.g. role=='registrar') even cross-tenant. If product intent is a true cross-tenant inbox for super_admin, consider widening the $or to include role-broadcasts of all roles when the requester is super_admin. Currently this is a defensible behavior but may be unexpected.

Editability gate selector `[data-testid^="gov-hitl-"]` also matches the panel testid `gov-hitl-cov`. Not a bug but tests should use a more specific selector like `[data-testid^="gov-hitl-"]:not([data-testid="gov-hitl-cov"])` or use role=switch.
